A.notes: All audit gates pass, no warnings. Leaf-on-progress-bar is a nice small moment; single sans family, tidy hierarchy; blobs on desktop are generic; Esc/keydown, aria-live, denied state handled. Phone frame at 1440 is soft rather than device-like.

B.notes: Charming mascot character and Fraunces/Nunito pairing give stronger personality. But contrast fails (white on #2f8f5b 4.04, grey 4.31 on Skip and body), 4 h1s, 5 touch targets <44px, 7 radii, reduced-motion shows 7 animations still running in audit (G4 doubtful). Has Maybe later, confetti, denied state.

why: B has the more delightful character and typography, but it fails the contrast gate (CTA, Skip and body text under 4.5:1) plus has 4 h1s and small touch targets, capping it at 50. A passes every gate cleanly with strong UX states, so I would ship A and have B's mascot and serif voice folded in after fixing its contrast.
